I build tools to improve data quality, improve efficiency, and create insightful dashboards to make informed business decisions.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at Willamette University,
where my capstone [predicts severity of rising stream temperatures](capstone.qmd) for
the City of Salem.

Driven by a commitment to environmental sustainability and public health, I build transparent, reproducible data workflows that turn complex models into clear, actionable insights.

**Currently** a Customer Care Specialist for Qorvo where I am supporting customer relations and creating prediction models for future product demand to support efficient manufacturing plans.
[Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
